name: observation_extract
description: Extract evidence-backed observations from one Raw Entry.
prompt_text: Extract only claims directly supported by the evidence. Do not invent facts.

input.content: node-3903 has a stale iscsi session.

name: classification
description: Classify a Raw Entry without changing its content.
prompt_text: Classify the entry into all useful content types. Return the primary type in content_type and the full set in content_types. Explain briefly.

name: summary
prompt_text: Summarize the evidence in a few sentences. Separate facts from uncertainty.

name: tag
description: Suggest a small set of normalized tags.
prompt_text: Suggest at most eight concise tags and reuse common existing terminology.

name: entity_extract
prompt_text: Extract only entities visible in the evidence with their types and mention text.

name: time_extract
prompt_text: Extract explicit times and temporal phrases; do not infer dates that are absent.

name: project_classify
description: Suggest an existing or evident project.
prompt_text: Suggest a project only when the evidence supports it.

name: topic_classify
prompt_text: Suggest a concise topic based only on the evidence.

name: relation_build
prompt_text: Return only explicit or strongly supported relationships.

name: memory_extract
description: Extract memory candidates while preserving evidence boundaries.
prompt_text: Extract durable or episodic candidates; never issue database operations here.

name: salience_evaluate
description: Evaluate durable, episodic or ignore salience.
prompt_text: Choose exactly one salience and preserve temporary wording as episodic.

name: memory_reconcile
prompt_text: Choose only ADD, SUPPORT, SUPERSEDE, CONFLICT, MERGE or IGNORE.

name: query_understanding
prompt_text: Extract intent, keywords, identifiers and time hints without answering.

name: answer
prompt_text: Use only supplied sources. Label inference and refuse unsupported certainty.
